mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, u.username as merchant_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.merchant_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, c.name as category_name, u.username as merchant_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.merchant_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, description, price, stock, image, category_id, merchant_id, status, sales, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{status}, #{sales}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock + #{quantity} >= 0
UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
